architecture.summary: Documents only: the owner accepted the D-15 recommendation of SO-01e on 27 October 2026, OPERATION_CAPACITY 5 for a free tenant and 10 for a team tenant. docs/implementation/self-onboarding-plan.md records the final answer in the D-15 row of section 5 with its measured basis and its consequence, and states the values in the design in short, the tenant column of the settings table, the tier change paragraph, the tier rules, the D-12 row, the SO-01e ticket, the Slice 2 introduction, SO-03, SO-06, SO-13, and the memory risk; the Slice 1 history stays. The two decision records under architecture/decisions/ get one dated amendment sentence each, in place (item 6 of the container record; line 12 and the capacity row of the tiers record), that points at plan section 5, and the Slice 1 record notes the acceptance under its Recommendation for D-15. The source default of OPERATION_CAPACITY stays 10, so the registry text "default 10" stays accurate; the provisioner and tier change tickets carry the values of each tier. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
